findings.checklist_item: Correct the _processors.py edit to delete the ENTIRE `from ._processors_status import (...)` statement (lines 26-31), not just the four inner name lines, since all four of its names are being removed.

An import statement with an empty parenthesized name list is a SyntaxError, so lines 26 and 31 must be removed too
findings.finding: The _processors.py edit instruction 'delete lines 21, 23, 24, 27-30' leaves a syntactically invalid empty import. Lines 27-30 are the ENTIRE name list of the `from ._processors_status import (` statement (lines 26-31); removing only the inner four lines leaves `from ._processors_status import (\n)`, a SyntaxError.
scenarios: Implementer deletes exactly lines 27-30 and leaves the empty `from ._processors_status import ()` wrapper, breaking import of the whole reducer package
findings.suggested_fix: State: 'delete lines 21, 23, 24 (identity re-exports) and the whole lines 26-31 `from ._processors_status import (...)` block, since all four of its imported names are the removed re-exports.'

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Re-parent this ADR-0111 shim-removal leaf under the epic/story that actually owns src/ and scripts/ shim migration (or correct the parent), since skaldic-paradoxal-huemul declares 'every file under src/ and scripts/' out of scope and already owns the only overlapping deliverable (the test_processors_status_split.py move).
evidence: Parent Scope (3f35): 'In scope: the 25 deleted files, the two new files, the renamed file, and the destinations named above. Out of scope: every file under src/ and scripts/, the Makefile, pyproject.toml, and every test module not named above.'

Grandparent epic (f400): 'This epic touches only tests/, scripts/, pyproject.toml, Makefile, .gitignore, .pre-commit-config.yaml, and docs/' — all in the service of retiring test-suite seam guards, not src/ shim migration.

Leaf Scope lists 'src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py (deleted)', 'src/rebar/reducer/{_processors,_replay}.py', 'the listed src/rebar/** importers', and 'scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py' — src/ and scripts/ work the parent forbids.

The only in-parent overlap is the test_processors_status_split.py DELETE-BUT-MOVE, which the parent already performs; the leaf states 'Then git rm the file (a no-op if that story landed first)', i.e. it duplicates rather than narrows the parent.
The leaf's own premise is ADR 0111 ('internal-only compatibility shims'), a concern absent from the parent's and grandparent's plans.
findings.finding: The leaf's core deliverables (deleting src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py, rewriting src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py and _replay.py, editing src/rebar/_ids.py, src/rebar/_alias.py, and scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py) fall entirely within the region the parent skaldic-paradoxal-huemul explicitly declares OUT OF SCOPE ('every file under src/ and scripts/'), so the leaf is not a subset of its parent — it is a different (ADR-0111 shim-removal) story that overlaps the parent only in the single test_processors_status_split.py move, which the parent already owns.
findings.location: Plan 'Scope' section vs parent skaldic-paradoxal-huemul 'Scope' ('Out of scope: every file under src/ and scripts/')
scenarios: A reviewer verifies the leaf against its declared parent's acceptance criteria and finds the bulk of the leaf's work (src/ deletions, _processors/_replay rewrites, _ids/_alias prose) is unaccounted-for by the parent and explicitly excluded by its Scope.
The parent story lands first and performs the test_processors_status_split.py move; the leaf's remaining src/scripts work has no parent contract authorizing it.
findings.suggested_fix: Move this leaf under the ADR-0111 'no internal-only compatibility shims' epic whose contract contains src/ and scripts/ shim deletion; drop the duplicated test_processors_status_split.py move (or make it an explicit dependency on skaldic-paradoxal-huemul) so the leaf narrows a parent that actually contains its src/scripts work.
